instruction: Write an XDP program that drops IPv4 packets with TTL <= 1 (expired / traceroute) or fragmented packets, and passes all others.
requirements: Drop IPv4 packets with fragmentation offset or MF flag set
Pass unfragmented IPv4 packets with TTL > 1 and all non-IPv4 packets

tests.name: test_low_ttl_drop
tests.description: IPv4 packet with TTL == 1 should be dropped

tests.name: test_normal_ttl_pass
tests.description: IPv4 packet with normal TTL should pass

tests.name: test_fragmented_drop
tests.description: Fragmented IPv4 packet (frag_off != 0) should be dropped
